H5329: properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent
H5058: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a stringed instrument; by extension, a poem set to music; specifically, an epigram
H4210: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H6030: properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H6664: the right (natural, moral or legal); also (abstractly) equity or (figuratively) prosperity
H6862: narrow; (as a noun) a tight place (usually figuratively, i.e. trouble); also a pebble ; (transitive) an opponent (as crowding)
H7337: to broaden (intransitive or transitive, literal or figurative)
H2603: properly, to bend or stoop in kindness to an inferior; to favor, bestow; causatively to implore (i.e. move to favor by petition)
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H8605: intercession, supplication; by implication, a hymn
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H3519: properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness
H157: to have affection for (sexually or otherwise)
H7385: emptiness; figuratively, a worthless thing; adverbially, in vain
H1245: to search out (by any method, specifically in worship or prayer); by implication, to strive after
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H7264: to quiver (with any violent emotion, especially anger or fear)
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing

H3824: the heart (as the most interior organ);
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H4904: a bed (figuratively, a bier); abstractly, sleep; by euphemism, carnal intercourse
H1826: to be dumb; by implication, to be astonished, to stop; also to perish
H2076: to slaughter an animal (usually in sacrifice)
H2077: properly, a slaughter, i.e. the flesh of an animal; by implication, a sacrifice (the victim or the act)
H982: figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure
H7227: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)

H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H6256: time, especially (adverb with preposition) now, when, etc.
H8492: must or fresh grape-juice (as just squeezed out); by implication (rarely) fermented wine
H7231: properly, to cast together , i.e. increase, especially in number; to multiply by the myriad
H7965: safe, i.e. (figuratively) well, happy, friendly; also (abstractly) welfare, i.e. health, prosperity, peace
H7901: to lie down (for rest, sexual connection, decease or any other purpose)

H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
